channel.title: ❄️ Pierre Munhoz engineering blog
channel.description: Last 10 notes on ❄️ Pierre Munhoz engineering blog

item.title: Majority Element
item.description: Learn how to solve the Majority Element problem from LeetCode using Python and the Boyer-Moore Voting Algorithm. Ideal for coding interviews.

item.title: Pierre Munhoz — Data Engineering, Analytics & More
item.description: Discover the engineering blog of Pierre Munhoz, a freelance Data Engineer. Explore insights on data engineering, analytics, and coding.

item.title: How to backup Airbyte on Google Cloud Storage?
item.description: I found on the airbyte forum how to backup the Airbyte instance to a new instance but I also used this resource to create a backup script of Airbyte.

item.title: What is Boyer-Moore majority vote algorithm?
item.description: Boyer–Moore majority vote algorithm The Boyer-Moore voting algorithm is a clever method to find the majority element in an array (an element that appears more than n/2 times) using O(1) space and O(n) time.

item.title: Best dbt Orchestration Tools: Dagster vs Airflow vs Prefect vs Actions
item.description: A practical, code-backed comparison of the top open-source dbt orchestration tools. Evaluate Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, and GitHub Actions based on observability, infrastructure overhead, and dbt-native integration.

item.title: How to Orchestrate dbt with Airflow & Cosmos (dbt Cloud Alternative)
item.description: Learn how to orchestrate dbt core with Apache Airflow and Astronomer Cosmos. Discover how to turn every dbt node into an Airflow task with full lineage, scheduling, and retries.

item.title: How to Orchestrate dbt with Dagster: The Best Open-Source Alternative
item.description: Learn how to orchestrate dbt with Dagster and dagster-dbt as a free dbt Cloud alternative. Includes a hands-on tutorial covering Software-Defined Assets, scheduling, retries, and Slim CI using DuckDB.

item.title: Automate dbt with GitHub Actions: CI/CD & Scheduling Guide
item.description: Automate your dbt-core pipelines using GitHub Actions with zero infrastructure. Learn how to set up git-native scheduling, Slim CI (state:modified+), and Slack failure notifications.

item.title: How to Orchestrate dbt with Prefect: A Lightweight Alternative
item.description: Learn how to orchestrate dbt Core with Prefect using lightweight Python flows. Step-by-step guide covering scheduling, retries, smoke checks, and full refreshes with minimal infrastructure.

item.title: dbt Multi-Project Without dbt Cloud: A Practical Guide to dbt-loom
item.description: Learn how to split a monolithic dbt project into domain-oriented projects and wire them together with dbt-loom, the open-source plugin that brings dbt Mesh-style cross-project refs to dbt Core — no dbt Cloud required. Includes a working demo with DuckDB, fan-out dependencies, CI deployment order, and a workaround for the docs lineage limitation.
